title: A real gym owner is told their demo gym is gone
what: When the sign-in on a real gym has ended, saving the gym look or uploading a product photo or logo shows: This demo gym is no longer available. Start a new demo gym. On the Branding page the owner stays on the page with that message and is not taken back to sign in.
expected: A signed-in owner is told the sign-in ended and is taken to sign in again; the demo words show only in a demo gym.
how_often: each time a sign-in ends while the owner is on Branding or adding a photo
fix_line: Send these failures through the same sign-in-ended path every other shop call uses
